preconditions.description: l is an integer within the range from 1 to 10^800.
r is an integer within the range from l to 10^800.
n is an integer within the range from 1 to 2000.

postconditions.description: The first line of the output contains the maximum possible number of modest substrings.
The second line of the output contains a string of length n having exactly the maximum number of modest substrings.
